observation.command: cd /workspace && echo "=== service endpoints ===" && for entry in "api http://localhost:3001/admin/login" "openapi http://localhost:3001/v1_openapi.json" "swagger http://localhost:3002/" "webdev http://localhost:3000/" "webdocker http://localhost:3003/"; do name=${entry%% *}; url=${entry#* }; code=$(curl -sL -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 25 "$url"); echo "$name ($url): $code"; done; echo "=== JSON:API token auth ===" && curl -s -o /dev/null -w "GET /api/v1/clubs: %{http_code}\n" -H "Authorization: Bearer 1|WEhI5anY6yAh3oK5kT9UANurD18WxMzXmbZrRQyt6236cae3" --max-time 10 http://localhost:3001/api/v1/clubs; echo "=== compose ps ===" && docker compose ps --format '{{.Service}}: {{.Status}}' 2>/dev/null | grep -v level=warning
